trigger: a foe condition's line on the long-press foe card
before: It hits only on its die's top face and never lands a critical, until it can see again: the count on the chip, or the whole fight if there is none. It is swinging at where you were a moment ago.
after: It hits only on its best roll (20 on a d20) and never lands a critical, until it can see again: the count on the chip, or the whole fight if there is none. It is swinging at where you were a moment ago.
why: TEXT-01 (user, 2026-09-30): "faces" wording becomes "+/− to hit" and a hard cap names its d20 range. A blind foe hits only on its best roll, 20 on a d20, and never lands a critical; derived.js#foeSwingChain applies the blind cap last, so an insult never widens it and only the plain case is stated.

trigger: a foe condition's line on the long-press foe card

trigger: a foe condition's line on the long-press foe card
